core_obligations: Part (1): algebra-object identification + the module glueing proposition
Part (2): reduce to the two-pullback criterion and apply fpqc descent of closed immersions
Part (3): same reduction with the finite descent lemma

difficulty_reason: (1) identify spaces affine over X with quasi-coherent O_X-algebras and the affine triples with algebra objects of QCoh(Y -> X, Z) (affine-equivalence lemma + relative Spec commuting with base change), so the module-level glueing proposition gives the equivalence; (2) full faithfulness from (1), essential surjectivity reduced (via (1)) to: X' -> X is a closed immersion iff both pullbacks to U and Y are - and {U -> X, Y -> X} is refined by an fpqc covering (lemma-dominate-by-fpqc-covering), so fpqc descent of closed immersions applies; (3) same argument with the finite-descent lemma.
